name: orch-lite
description: Lightweight multi-agent orchestration skill. Routes every request into one of three states - chat, single background dispatch, or index+worktree orchestration - so the main agent only coordinates while all file-modifying work runs in background child agents. Use when a request involves writing or modifying files, git/build operations, or coordinating multiple child agents.

interface.shortDescription: Lightweight multi-agent orchestration for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Use Orch-lite to route every request into chat, single background dispatch, or index+worktree orchestration, so the main agent only coordinates while all file-modifying work runs in background child agents.
defaultPrompt: Dispatch this as a background child agent and keep coordinating.
Orchestrate this multi-item request with index + worktrees.
